results.title: Crash Site
results.overview: An object crash lands in the wilderness and hikers, Max and Ben recover it before the authorities can. Max's growing obsession with the mysterious device leads this strange and solitary man to the point of self sacrifice, certain that he's made a profound discovery and possibly first contact with an alien race.

results.title: Elaichi
results.overview: On their wedding night, a groom's excitement and a bride’s haunted past collide in this tender, humorous tale of second chances and societal expectations.

results.title: TV-2: Kys det satans liv
results.overview: The Aarhus-based band TV-2 has broken down generation gaps and helped define Danish humor, and lead singer Steffen Brandt’s lyrics have become a soundtrack to 45 years of Danish history.

results.title: Dans l’ombre
results.overview: As night falls, Alice and Clément run breathlessly. In the heart of an oppressive nature, something mysterious is stalking them. They have only two certainties: what is pursuing them is aggressive, and it sees in the dark...

results.title: Blood Ties
results.overview: A 19th century tragedy of feuding families and duelling affairs amongst the rugged landscapes of Cornwall

results.title: Jaguars
results.overview: In the Mexican jungle, the jaguar prowls and haunts people's minds. While different perspectives on this nocturnal predator clash, a child who is gradually losing his sight approaches the animal.

results.title: Written in the Sand
results.overview: Daniella Charles is the hard-working manager of The Sundial Resort and Spa, located on a small island near the Florida coast. She has always dreamed of big accomplishments "someday," but she's in for a surprise when her meticulous work plans suddenly lead her to saving her hometown, and to love.

results.title: Seven days in May
results.overview: David Riondino, an Italian film director, is coming to Spain to document the Atocha massacre of 1977, to make a film on its 50th anniversary. He will be helped by Alejandra, a young documentary filmmaker who urges him to contextualise the past with the current rise of the far right. By investigating the Atocha attack, David will recover a part of that recent past and at the same time will witness a reality that encourages reflection on some burning issues such as the advance of the far right, problems of access to housing and job insecurity.

results.title: Wrong Turns
results.overview: An anthology of thrillers that explores what it means to navigate an unkind world and struggle to keep your head.

results.title: Third Act
results.overview: Filmmaker Tadashi explores his father Robert A. Nakamura's life as an influential Asian American artist and activist, while grappling with Robert's Parkinson's diagnosis, navigating themes of art, grief, and their father-son relationship.

results.title: Mount Mutombo
results.overview: A powerful chronicle of the extraordinary life of NBA legend Dikembe Mutombo. Through rare interviews with teammates, coaches, and family, the film captures Dikembe’s journey from his humble beginnings in Congo to his immense impact on and off the basketball court.

results.title: Martina's Search
results.overview: Martina, who has Alzheimer's, has been searching for her grandson for over three decades. Discovering he is in Brazil, her long and solitary journey becomes an intense struggle against time and oblivion.

results.title: Raastein
results.overview: A man’s unconventional tour of Udaipur City.

results.title: Violets
results.overview: In 1945, beneath the oppressive shadow of the Francoist dictatorship, Juan, a university teacher assistant, meets Manuel during a chance encounter at night in a park. With their initial reservations, a complex love story unfolds between them, shaped by the turbulent political climate and the misunderstanding of those around them.

results.title: Bella
results.overview: After years of caring for her father, Bella falls for Ponce, a dreamer she sees as her prince charming. As their romance leads to marriage, she gradually loses herself, abandoning her studies, friends, and family for his world.

results.title: The Good Manners
results.overview: In a Valencian village, during the postwar period, Ana tries to get ahead with her family; the civil war has opened a deep wound in all of them, especially in her brother-in-law, Antonio. Ana tries to heal that wound with stews, secrets and silences, but when Isabel, newly married to Antonio, comes to the family, Ana’s attention and care will be worth little or nothing: the sacrifice does not always have its reward.

results.title: And the Breadwinner Is...
results.overview: When Bambi discovers that her family has squandered their savings, they devise a plan to cover their debts — but first, she must fake her death.

results.title: Gemini
results.overview: In the ebb and flow of their relationship, a woman believes she knows the man she loves...until an unexpected event exposes a side of him she never saw coming. Based on true events, GEMINI is a darkly comedic and intimate portrait of love, loss, and secrecy.

results.title: Obscure Night - "Ain't I a Child?"
results.overview: After having walked the streets of Mellila, Malik, Mehdi, and Hassan now beat the cobblestones of Paris, discovering its lights and its chimeras, its joys and its violence...

results.title: Gods of Cable City
results.overview: A reclusive townie wanders through dying dive bars of Mahanoy City, seeking purpose in the forgotten birthplace of cable television.
